description: Dead-man's switch for the flap monitor itself. The monitor's error path (script failure, SUPERVISOR_TOKEN loss, log-fetch failure, or cam_health dying - which starves the span clock and trips the freshness guard) lands binary_sensor.cameras_flapping in 'unavailable'. Without this automation that state is terminal-silent. 60 min clears benign windows (HA/Scrypted restarts recover in 5-15 min) while catching every permanent-death mode.

data.title: 📹 Flap monitor down
